title: Down by the Old Mill Stream

evidence.note: Wikipedia states Tell Taylor wrote the song in 1908 but it was copyrighted and published on August 12, 1910 by Tell Taylor Music Publisher, Chicago.
IMSLP catalog lists the first editions as 1910 (M. Witmark & Sons, New York, and Star Music, Chicago), confirming 1910 as the publication year even though the tune was written in 1908.

famous_use: Groucho and Chico Marx sing it a cappella while posing as doctors in A Day at the Races (1937).
